documents.title: Bambu Lab X2D Spec Sheet
documents.note: Three pages headed "X2D Spec". The store "Specs" block links it as a "Download PDF" button (downloadButton.downloadUrl); the package collects no document from this page, so this curated entry is its only document row.

notes: Dual-hotend keys used instead of the generic ones: extrusion.main_/aux_extruder_gear and _motor carry the sheet's "Toolhead" and "Auxiliary Extruder" rows (the store table labels them "Main …" and "Auxiliary …"), and printing.filament_main_hotend / filament_aux_hotend / filament_aux_hotend_caution carry the three "Filament Supported" rows. extrusion.extruder_gear, extrusion.extruder_motor and printing.supported_filament are therefore neither specs nor not_published (the facts are published, under the dual keys).

Left out on purpose (neither a spec nor not_published): connectivity.npu (the sheet says "Quad-core ARM with dedicated NPU" under Application Processor but gives no NPU row or figure), connectivity.interface (a USB port is named only inside the Storage row and two 6-pin ports only in FAQ 6), electrical.requirements (a group heading whose footnote 2 is region evidence), printing.working_area (laser), electrical.battery / electrical.connector, and the keys no product document carries (identity.*, carton.*, compat.statement, part.material, variant.note, package.volume_m3, manufacturer_terms.*).

Package gap, not a data gap: for this page-builder page the package parses none of the three tables the page carries (content-block-19 "Specs", content-block-18 "What's in the box", the FAQ) and collects no document (the spec sheet is a downloadButton). The deterministic payload therefore holds only electrical.voltage (us_110v, from the Product Features bullet), six not_found rows and one variant.note. Every store-table value was compared by hand with the sheet; the only disagreement is "Support for PA/PET" in the main-hotend list (conflict noted on printing.filament_main_hotend).

Marketing numbers not recorded: "31 sensors", "20 kHz" PMSM sampling, "over 1,000,000 switch cycles", "roughly every three months" firmware updates, "up to 30%" shorter print time with high-flow hotends. Noise ("below 50 dB") is kept unverified.

Not recorded: the "X2D Combo Print with Care Bundle" variant description (a bundle offer naming a sum of money and four extra PLA Pure rolls) and the "Product Variation Notice" (some production batches have a silicone wiper near the nozzle-switching area, replaced by a software update; both perform identically).
The two bundle values ("X2D Print More Bundle (2 AMS 2 Pro included)", "X2D Combo Print with Care Bundle") have no official packing list or gross weight; no row is scoped to them.
